source.title: Field Office Locator ZIP code assignment data
source.method: Rows with IsRetired=TRUE excluded. Grouped by the CSV State column, then counted by field office (ZIP codes, counties, and the CSV City column for places). A County of "None" (Connecticut) is treated as missing.

limits: Assignment is by ZIP code of residence; the applicant's own notice names the office.
A field office holds interviews and does not do the immigration medical exam.
